Power 
 Station

Technical 
 Procedure

Equipment:Lube Oil Pump
 Buffalo Forge Co. - Pump Division
Introduction

This document outlines the minor maintenance procedures P1, which must be 
performed for every five years as indicated by Y5 in the above title block

The 
first draft initiated by eng. Ali Fahmy, tested by eng. El-Sayed Mahmoud El-Kholy, 
accepted by eng. Sawsan El lithe 
general manager, revised by eng. 
Zakaria El-Shahat 
EDEPC MPIS coordinator and approved by 
eng. Mohamed Hussein Gomaa quality insurance head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued

Wear your safety helmet, shoes ... 
 etc
Caution marks must be hanged on a work place, safety rope around a work place
Disconnect the DC & AC power supply

Complete maintenance tool set
Rags

Rags

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Disassembly

Remove the pump from tank 
pump may have small quantities of oil trapped in internal, that will run out when removed 
from tank

Loosen locking plates 
(131) and remove bolts (102) and locking plates (131) holding strainer (59) to 
casing (2), remove strainer (59)

Remove discharge pipe 
bolts (108) and nuts (232). Break seal at discharge flange

Remove oil circulation 
line (76) by loosening parker "F" fittings (78). Use care in removing, not kink 
so as to prevent reuse, this is oil line to bearing and must be free from 
restrictions

Loosen locking plates 
(136) securing cap screws (102 f) and loosen cap screws swing lugs (240) 90 
out of contact with drive side plate. It is not necessary to remove bolts ahd 
lugs - only to loosen

items:
Remove the pump from tank 
pump may have small quantities of oil trapped in internal, that will run out when removed 
from tank

Loosen locking plates 
(131) and remove bolts (102) and locking plates (131) holding strainer (59) to 
casing (2), remove strainer (59)

Remove discharge pipe 
bolts (108) and nuts (232). Break seal at discharge flange

Remove oil circulation 
line (76) by loosening parker "F" fittings (78). Use care in removing, not kink 
so as to prevent reuse, this is oil line to bearing and must be free from 
restrictions

Loosen locking plates 
(136) securing cap screws (102 f) and loosen cap screws swing lugs (240) 90 
out of contact with drive side plate. It is not necessary to remove bolts ahd 
lugs - only to loosen

Tighten jack - screws 
(242) evenly and break joint between casing cover (6) and casing (2) remove 
casing (2)

Remove true - arc 
retaining ring (83)

Remove flex loc nut (15) 
and washer (16)

Remove impeller (3) and 
feather key (17) impeller will normally slide off shaft without use of 
appreciable force. Do not HAMMER on impeller under any circumstances, if use of 
wheel puller is required be certain pull is steady, evenly applied around shaft 
and parallel with shaft axis, in order to avoid damage to shaft or other parts, 
hydraulic balance holes may be used as jackscrew holes, by use of suitable tap 
and jackscrews (this is emergency procedure only when other means arc either not 
available or ineffective)

Loosen locking plates 
(137) and remove cap - screws (102 E) and locking plates (137)

Remove casing cover (6) 
with guide bearing (111B) from connecting pipe (50)

Remove lower guide 
BEARING (11B)
 * Loosen locking plate (137A) and remove cap 
screw (102) locking plate (137A) and 
 retaining clip (238B)
 * Guide bearing (11B) which is now free if bearing is 
to be reused and not replaced. It is 
 suggested that it not be removed from 
casing cover
 * Suitability for bearing reuse visual inspection of 
bearing surfaces and examination of 
 clearances on wearing rings and 
impeller rings should also require replacement of lower 
 or guide bearing

Remove upper thrust 
bearing (ball bearing (27))
 * Remove pump half of coupling (68) this may 
require use of wheel puller and care 
 should be exercised to see that 
pull is even, steady and parallel with shaft to avoid 
 possible damage to shaft or 
other parts
 * Loosen locking plates (131) and remove cap 
screws (102 C) CONNECTING PIPE 
 (50) with shaft (7) upper 
bearing assembly and pump half coupling is now of cover 
 plate (56) and may be removed
 * Separate bearing housing (38 B) from connecting 
pipe (50) remove shaft (7) with 
 bearing assembly from 
connecting pipe (50) 
 * Remove cap screws cap screws (102 A) and 
bearing cover (24) tab on bearing lock 
 washer (28) may be disengaged 
and bearing lock - nut (29) remove
 * Remove bearing (27) and bearing housing (38 B) 
from shaft with bearing puller or shop 
 press remove bearing (27) from 
housing (38 B)
 * Remove bearing seals (30 and 30 A) if required
 Note : Ball bearing (27) if 
removed from shaft should not reused except in case of 
 emergency and should be 
replaced with new bearing at reassembly

Remove & 
replace wearing rings (9) and (10) if clearance exceed 0.16 radial.
Destruction original rings is required to remove from seats. Bronze rings should 
be drilled on opposite sides. Split and removed in two pieces. Graphitar rings 
should be broken out by use of cold chisel or punch and hammer

Assembly 
wearing rings (9) and (10) in casing

Assembly upper 
thrust bearing (ball bearing (28))
 * Assembly bearing seals (30 and 30 A) if 
required
 * Assembly bearing (27) in housing (38 B)
 * Assembly bearing (27) and bearing housing (38 
B) in shaft with bearing puller or press
 * Assembly cap screws (102 A) and bearing cover 
(24) tab on bearing lock washer (28) 
 may be disengaged and bearing 
lock - nut (29) removed
 * Connect pipe (50) into bearing housing (50)
 * Assembly upper bearing with shaft (7) connecting pipe 
(50) and assembly cap screws 
 (102C) tighten locking plates (131)
 * Assembly pump half of coupling (68) this may require 
use of wheel puller and care 
 should be exercised to see that pull 
is even, steady and parallel with shaft to avoid 
 possible damage to shaft or other 
parts

Assembly lower 
guide BEARING (11B)
 * Assembly guide bearing (11 B)
 * Assembly retaining clip (238) and locking plate 
(137 A) and cap screw and tighten 
 locking plate (137 A)

Assembly 
casing cover (6) with guide bearing (111 B) from connecting pipe (50)

Assembly cap - 
screws (102 E) and tighten locking plates (137)

Assembly 
lmpeller (3) and feather key (17) lmpeller will normally slide off shaft without 
use of appreciable force

Assembly flex 
loc nut (15) and washer (16)

Assembly tru-arc 
retaining ring (83)

Tighten 
jack-screws (242) evenly and assembly joint between casing cover (6) and casing 
(2)

Tighten 
locking plates (136) securing cap screws (102 f) and loosen cap screws swing 
lugs (240) 90 out of contact with drive side 
plate. It is not necessary to remove bolts and lugs - only to loosen

Assembly oil circulation line (76) by loosening 
parker "F" fittings use care in removing not kink so as to prevent reuse this is 
oil line to bearing and must be free from restrictions

Assembly discharge pipe bolts (108) and nuts (232) 
put seal at discharge flange

Assembly strainer (59) to casing (2) holding 
strainer (59) and locking plates (131) and assembly bolts (102) tighten locking 
plates (131)
Assembly the pump into tank
